name: armis-knowledge-stage
description: STAGE environment (knowledge-mcp.moose-stg.armis.com). Adds /knowledge, /cwe-fix, /framework-guidance, and /tech-guidance commands. Reads ARMIS_CLIENT_ID, ARMIS_CLIENT_SECRET, and ARMIS_KNOWLEDGE_TENANT_SLUG; exchanges them for a short-lived JWT on startup. Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.
